modules.name: daily-rewards
modules.description: Configurable daily reward entry: a HUD side icon (left or right) or the center slot of the bottom menu, with the same item handle in both zones. Session-fixed build settings choose the entry (hud or bottomMenu), the HUD side, the local icon, the ready badge and autoOpen (true: open the calendar once per session on entry only when the reward for today is claimable by server time; false: never); setNextRewardAt sets the countdown timer of the entry. The module registers the named windows main, board, month, gift and reward with sdk.ui; the host opens the UI Kit window of the same name; the server owns all grants. Connection: dailyRewardsModule() from @manygamescorp/mod-daily-rewards/daily-rewards, passed to createSdk({ modules: [dailyRewardsModule()] }) and listed in the app with sdk.modules.set. plan() returns DailyPlan { track, window, cycleLength, onMiss, days: DailyPlanDay[] { day, reward[] { id, amount } }, title?, subtitle? }; the result table below lists every field. Automatic presentation honors the UI Kit windowQueue setting and waits for the host dismissal acknowledgement.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens the existing UI Kit calendar through the host's declared event handler.

methods.name: plan
methods.description: Reads the card's per-day rewards, cycle, miss rule and window texts for the window.

returns.description: A frozen plan built from the settings; no server call.

track.description: Progress record key the server keeps the chain in.

window.description: UI Kit window variant selected in the module card.

cycleLength.description: Number of days in the cycle, 1..31.

days.description: Exactly `cycleLength` days; a day without an authored reward has an empty list.

day.description: Day number in the cycle, starting at 1.

reward.description: Authored inventory rewards for this day.

amount.description: Positive quantity of the inventory entity.

title.description: Localized window title or its localization key.

key.description: Localization key resolved by the host.

subtitle.description: Localized window subtitle or its localization key.

key.description: Localization key resolved by the host.

methods.name: setNextRewardAt
methods.description: Update the entry from the server's next-reward schedule.

endsAt.description: Server epoch milliseconds; null clears the countdown.

events.name: daily-rewards:board:open
events.description: Window board was opened with sdk.ui.open('daily-rewards:board'). The host presents the UI Kit dailyBoard window (services/daily-rewards).

events.name: daily-rewards:calendar:open
events.description: The player requested the daily rewards calendar (window main). The host presents the UI Kit week window (services/progress dailyReward).

events.name: daily-rewards:gift:open
events.description: Window gift was opened. The host presents the UI Kit dailyGift window.

events.name: daily-rewards:month:open
events.description: Window month was opened. The host presents the UI Kit dailyCalendar window, the cross-game ManyPlay calendar.

events.name: daily-rewards:reward:open
events.description: Window reward was opened. The host presents the UI Kit rewardWindow window for a reward the server already confirmed.

events.name: daily-rewards:window:close
events.description: The UI Kit queue asks the host to dismiss the named daily reward window.

name.description: Window registration name (main, board, month, gift or reward).
